ModMetaData.name: Quick Menu
ModMetaData.author: Sixdd6
ModMetaData.description:
Quick Menu is a radial wheel or grid of your favourite build and order buttons. It opens around the mouse.
Ctrl+click any button in the architect menu to pin it (Alt with Dubs Mint Menus). Press Mouse 4 (or middle mouse, or any key you set) to open the menu. Includes a material ring, dropdown sub-rings, and an edit mode to rearrange pins.
Requires Harmony. Load it before this mod. Nothing is saved in your save files.
